verdict.rationale: Unity is a development platform with cloud services, MCP and CLI tooling, so issuing scoped credentials for agents is a fair question for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents scoped, least-privilege API keys, service accounts or per-agent permission controls. The MCP server, CLI and Unity Credits evidence covers agent connectivity and metering, not credential scoping.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
